description: Get a product's observed prices per airport over time: SkyBuyFly's 50 most recent observations (the answer says which dates they cover), as each airport's price changes, with the lowest and latest price. Relevant when a traveller asks whether a price is good, has changed or how it developed. It does not check current prices.

currency.description: A 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR (any case; default USD), that every price is shown in; list_currencies has every one.
currency.title: Currency

product_id.description: A SkyBuyFly product_id exactly as search_products, lookup_barcode or get_featured_products answered it: 32 lowercase hex characters or a dashed UUID.
product_id.title: Product Id

name: get_price_history

AirportHistory.description: A product's observed prices at one airport (``code`` null: an online shop serving several airports).
AirportHistory.title: AirportHistory

Money.description: An amount in an ISO 4217 currency, rounded to cents.
Money.title: Money

outputSchema.description: ``get_price_history``: the product (for the widget's header) and its recent observations per airport.
outputSchema.title: HistoryResult

title: Get a product's price history
